identityOwnership.rowVersionPolicy: Existing @Version com_users.version is a conservative JPA person-binding stamp. Profile/JPA updates may invalidate it; not a person-only revision or complete lifecycle revision. Native account activation SQL changes status without incrementing version/access_revision, so current owner status must be checked independently. access_revision remains an independently checked current-access stamp. Neither proves signed freshness.
